fields.label: Class name
fields.help: If filled, it will be displayed in the booking as well as in the client's attendance record.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: This description is shown to clients during the booking process. Use it to add helpful details about this class, such as the class format, target level, or anything clients should know before booking.

fields.label: Meeting ID
fields.help: Enter only the meeting ID of your Google Meet or Zoom meeting (do not paste the full link).

fields.label: Limit the number of bookings
fields.help: Maximum number of participants. One participant can occupy more than one slot and thus fill the capacity. For example, in the case of birthday celebrants at a birthday party. If zero is entered, the setting is ignored. If the maximum number of participants is reached, the class will no longer appear in booking forms.

fields.label: Notify instructor about client's cancellation:
options: Only if the client cancels less than a week before the session

cards.title: Class properties
intro: Class start and end dates are usually set automatically based on the first and last session. But you can adjust them if needed — for example, if the first or last session gets cancelled or rescheduled. It’s especially important if you let your clients reschedule sessions, since they’ll only be able to pick dates within this range.

fields.label: Class type
options: Fixed period class — A class you're committed to running, with set start and end dates — even if a few details like the trainer aren't final yet.
Lead collection — Collect sign-ups before anything is scheduled. Use it to test demand before committing to dates and a venue, or as a general pool you later split into separate classes.

fields.label: Allow online booking
fields.help: Displays/hides the programme from the booking form. Thus, whether the programme will be (dis)enabled on your website for online booking.

fields.label: Trial sessions
fields.help: Determines whether this class will be available in trial sessions

fields.label: Auto-enrolment Active
fields.help: If enabled, this class will be offered to clients as a follow-up option through auto-enrolment after their current programme ends.

fields.label: Class capacity
fields.help: Maximum number of slots that can be filled

fields.label: Session duration
fields.help: The change will also affect existing sessions.

cards.title: Delete
intro: The class will be deleted from the database and will no longer appear in the list or calendar.

cards.title: disabled at the programme level › Trial settings
intro: If you offer trial sessions for this programme, you can set them up here.

fields.label: Trial type
options: Free Trial (Single Session) — Clients enrol for one free trial session. No payment is required, and Zooza will not generate any debt for this booking.

Free Trial (Multiple Sessions) — Clients enrol once and gain free access to all upcoming sessions within the trial period. Zooza will not generate any debt.Use the “Trial Length” setting to define how many days the trial lasts after the first session is selected.
Paid Trial (Single Session) — Clients enrol for one paid trial session. Zooza will generate debt equal to the price of a single session.

Paid Trial (Multiple Sessions) — Clients enrol once and pay for multiple upcoming sessions within the trial period. Zooza will generate debt for each session based on the price settings. Use the “Trial Length” setting to control how long the client remains enrolled.
Lead collection — Use this if you don't want to allow clients to enrol in class sessions directly instead enrol in an empty class, and you’ll enrol them into classes manually.
